points: Optical losses and electro-optic interfaces dominate power, blocking commercial cloud photonic tensor cores
Best near-term fit: ultralow-latency edge tasks such as on-fibre processing and vision
UC Irvine authors see photonics as viable within the existing digital stack over the next decade
read: Perspective, Nature Photonics vol. 20 (October 2026 issue), published online 15 September 2026
take: Peer-reviewed reality check for photonic AI hardware: edge and on-fibre uses come first; datacentre tensor cores stay blocked by optical losses and interface power.
title: Nature Photonics: photonic AI chips not yet ready for the cloud
